$comment: Input of scripts/gen_error_codes.py (OBS-5); the generated catalogue is docs/runbooks/error-codes.md. category_defaults: the action of every row without a code entry. codes.<code>.action: a quotation (string, or list of quotations) of the document named in 'source', which must also name the code; the check refuses anything that is not found verbatim there. codes.<code>.meaning: a sentence written after reading the call site named in 'basis', used where the message is built at run time. doc_reference_allow: dotted tokens of the checked documents that are not codes, each with the reason.

INVALID_INPUT.action: The backend refused a value, so nothing was saved. Correct it and send it again.

UNAUTHORIZED.action: Policy does not allow this action here. Nothing was changed.

APPROVAL_REQUIRED.action: This action changes a protected record, so it waits for you. Approve the request, then apply it. The approval covers exactly these values and nothing else.

STALE_REVISION.action: It was changed after this window loaded it, so your change was not applied. Reload to see the current version, then make your change again.

PRECONDITION_FAILED.action: The record is not in a state that allows this, or this part is not built yet. Nothing was changed.

NOT_FOUND.action: That record does not exist or is not in the loaded data. Check the name or the code.

CONFLICT.action: Another request used the same key, or the record was changed at the same moment. Look at the current record, then send your change again.

action: Something this needs is not available: storage, the model, or the link to the backend. Planning, notes and timers do not need a model.
Retryable categories show one button, "Try again".
The action was stopped at its time limit and nothing partial was kept.
Retryable categories show one button, "Try again".

CANCELLED.action: The action was cancelled before it finished. Nothing partial was kept.

action: The local database was busy for a moment. Nothing was lost.
Retryable categories show one button, "Try again".

DATA_CORRUPTION.action: Stored data did not pass an integrity check. Stop here and verify a backup in Settings/Recovery before you continue.

INTERNAL.action: The cause is written to the local log. Nothing sensitive is shown here.

curriculum.promotion_blocked.action: the candidate changed after the review: reconcile again and review the new diff

restore.database_in_use.action: Stop every process that has the data directory open (the desktop shell, any `g9` command).
restore.database_in_use.meaning: Another connection holds or uses the live database; nothing was changed.

restore.backup_not_retained.action: Choose a `RETAINED` backup: `g9 status --data-dir DIR` names the newest (`last_backup.backup_id`); the id is also the `backup_id` returned by `backup.create`.

restore.live_database_missing.action: use `g9 restore --snapshot DIR/backups/ID.sqlite --expect-sha256 HEX ...` with the checksum from the manifest as printed by an earlier `backup.*` call (`manifest_sha256`) or from your own record; a snapshot is verified in any case.

recovery.integrity_failed.action: Do not edit the database. Take the newest backup that verifies (`g9 call backup.list`, `backup.verify`), restore it by the procedure above, and redo what was done after it.

assessment.definition_invalid.meaning: `AssessmentDefinition::new` refused the definition built from the request (title, competency, kind); the message is the text of the rule that failed.

assessment.version_invalid.meaning: The first version of the new assessment could not be sealed with its checksum (`AssessmentVersion::with_checksum`); the message is the reason.

attachment.media_type_invalid.meaning: The declared media type of the attached file was refused by the evidence checks (`EvidenceError::MediaTypeInvalid`); the message is the reason.

competency.invalid.meaning: A competency built from the request or from a pack entry failed its validation (`validate()`); the message names the rule that failed.

curriculum.manifest.invalid.meaning: The manifest failed validation; the message counts the errors, invariant violations and warnings, and the details carry the validation report.

retention.plan_invalid.meaning: The review plan could not be computed from the due items, the budget and the time estimate (`plan_reviews`); the message is the reason.

retention.schedule_invalid.meaning: The next review date of an item could not be computed from the recorded outcome (`BaselineSchedule::next_after`); the message is the reason.

skills.envelope_invalid.meaning: The skill invocation envelope built from the request was refused when it was constructed; the message is the reason.

policy.denied.meaning: A policy rule denied the action; the message is the rule's reason, and the details name the rule, the action and the resource kind.

policy.approval_required.meaning: A policy rule requires your approval for this action; the message is the rule's reason, and the details name the rule, the required capability, the action and the resource kind.

skills.policy_denied.meaning: Policy denied this skill invocation; the message is the reason of the policy decision.

skills.approval_required.meaning: Policy requires your approval for this skill invocation; the message is the reason of the policy decision.

ai.inference.budget.meaning: The inference request cannot be honoured (`InferenceRequest::check_budget`): no output tokens, no timeout, a temperature outside [0, 2], or a prompt and output that exceed the context window; the message says which.

skills.preflight_failed.meaning: The skill package failed the checks made before it runs (`Orchestrator::preflight`); the message is the reason.

skills.request_build_failed.meaning: The model request for the skill could not be built from its package and envelope (`Orchestrator::build_request`); the message is the reason.

skills.cancelled.meaning: The skill invocation was cancelled; the message says when: before or during the preflight, before the run, while running (the late response is discarded), or because the backend reported a cancellation.

{area}.not_implemented.meaning: The operation or option is PROPOSED and nothing was executed. `{area}` is the first segment of the operation name for the PROPOSED operations of `teaching`, `analytics`, `executive` and `research` (`PROPOSED_OPERATIONS` in `crates/g9-app/src`); the codes the storage layer spells out are rows of the `PRECONDITION_FAILED` table.

restore.checksum_mismatch.meaning: The snapshot's SHA-256 differs from the expected value, or the file changed while it was being copied; the live database was not changed.

restore.schema_too_new.meaning: The snapshot's schema version is newer than the newest migration this build knows (no downgrade); the live database was not changed.

restore.snapshot_invalid.meaning: The snapshot path is unusable (missing, not a regular file, not a self-contained snapshot) or the expected checksum is malformed; nothing was changed.

restore.snapshot_is_live.meaning: The snapshot and the live database are the same file; nothing was changed.

restore.live_path_invalid.meaning: The live database path is unusable (a missing parent directory, or a directory); nothing was changed.

restore.swap_failed.meaning: Moving the files failed; the live database was put back where possible, and the message says what happened.

storage.disk_full.action: free space on that disk, then repeat the command

backup.insufficient_space.action: free space on the disk of the backups folder, then create the backup again

doc_reference_allow.goals.list: an operation name the document marks as planned and not built; it is not in crates/g9-app/src/ops.rs and is not an error code
doc_reference_allow.system.status.last_backup: a field of the system.status result (crates/g9-app/src/status.rs), not an error code
doc_reference_allow.last_backup.backup_id: a field of the g9 status output, not an error code
doc_reference_allow.attachments.copied: a field of the g9 copy-backup and g9 restore output (apps/cli/src/commands/copy_backup.rs), not an error code
doc_reference_allow.attachments.missing: a field of the g9 copy-backup and g9 restore output (apps/cli/src/commands/copy_backup.rs), not an error code
doc_reference_allow.recovery.restored: a domain event the document marks as PROPOSED (not implemented), not an error code
